title: Logspace-uniform circuits for polynomial-time languages
statement: Every language of Boolean strings decidable in polynomial time has a logspace-uniform family of Boolean circuits with at most two inputs per gate, of polynomial size, whose accepted language is exactly the given language.
hypotheses_covered: The language belongs to the class of polynomial-time decidable Boolean languages
